name_in_paper: reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) of DENV RNA

evidence.quote: The diagnosis of DENV infection was also confirmed if at least one of the following criteria was met in the acute phase serum: (1) positive reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) of DENV RNA, (2) positive serology for dengue IgM, or (3) positive dengue-specific non-structural antigen-1 (NS1).
The serology was performed by DENV-specific IgG ELISAs and flow cytometry-based neutralization assays, as previously described [ 26 ].
